title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：percentage　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 percentage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the researcher ① counted the percentage that no student in the lab would have recorded, and he said the counting was the whole of the term. The ② percentage, meaning the share itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a percentage, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ percentage in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ percentage at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A percentage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the researcher said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the percentage was the whole of the matter, meaning the measure and not the share. The ⑥ percentage, meaning the measure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; percentage, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a share and a measure. He said the measure is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ percentage had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ percentage of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of recording; percentage, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ percentage I remember is the share recorded in the paper, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ percentage, my mother said in 1983, is the only share that improves by being recorded; every percentage, she said, is a measure that has agreed to look like a share. She said the measure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 百分比（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 百分比（指那个百分比本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the percentage 算出这一个百分比
D. n. 百分比（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 百分比之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的百分比之事）
F. n. 百分比（指研究报告里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 百分比、分寸（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分寸（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the percentage that no student in the lab would have recorded

the percentage at the far bench

answers.why: count the percentage 意为“算出这一个百分比”，1974 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记载的一个百分比做了一遍。
percentage 意为“百分比”，指那个百分比本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记载。
percentage 意为“百分比”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
percentage 意为“百分比”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
percentage 意为“百分比、分寸”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个分寸就是那件事的全部。
percentage 意为“分寸”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个百分比，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
percentage 意为“百分比”，指研究报告里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1979 年这一个成了研究报告里的一行。
percentage 意为“百分比之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的百分比之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记载。
percentage 意为“百分比”，我记得的是研究报告里记载过的那一个，1981 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
percentage 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，百分比是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的百分比。
